SUMMARY: BedFactory builds a complete bed by extending BedFrameFactory (itself a specialized ChairFactory): it generates a frame (seat platform, legs, headboard/back decorations), a mattress, layered bedding (quilt/comforter driven by cloth simulation), a fabric cover, plus scattered pillows and towels. The upper-level files define the frame geometry, mattress/pillow/blanket/clothes sub-factories, and the assembly/scatter logic that positions and cloth-sims everything together. NOTE: the current code produces a low-post platform bed with a headboard — there is NO four-poster/canopy/curtain support; achieving the requested ornate four-poster canopy bed requires adding new post, canopy-rail, and draped-curtain geometry (currently absent).

EDITABLE (upper-level files — change these to alter the result):

FILE: assets/objects/seating/bed.py
  BedFactory: top-level assembly of frame + mattress + bedding + pillows + towels.
    knobs: mattress_types(weighted 1 coiled / 3 wrapped) -> mattress surface style; sheet_types(weighted 4 quilt / 4 comforter / 4 box_comforter / 1 none) -> bedding style; sheet_folded(uniform<0.5) -> whether sheet is folded back; has_cover(uniform<0.5) -> extra draped cover present (note: has_cover set but make_cover always called)
    knobs: n_pillows(randint 2..3) -> pillow count; n_towels(randint 1..1) -> towel count; pillow scatter x(uniform 0.1..0.4 * size), y(uniform -0.3..0.3 * width) -> pillow placement near head; towel scatter x(uniform 0.5..0.8 * size) -> towel placement toward foot; pillow final z offset(0.02); rotation_euler[-1](uniform 0..pi)
  mattress_factory: width(width*uniform 0.88..0.96), size(size*uniform 0.88..0.96) -> mattress fit inside frame
  quilt_factory: width(mattress.width*uniform 1.4..1.6), size(mattress.size*uniform 0.9..1.1) -> quilt overhang
  comforter_factory / box_comforter_factory: width(*uniform 1.4..1.8), size(*uniform 0.9..1.2) -> comforter drape amount
  cover_factory: width(*uniform 1.6..1.8), size(*uniform 0.3..0.4) -> narrow foot-of-bed throw
    make_sheet: pressure per type (quilt 0, comforter uniform 1.0..1.5, box log_uniform 8..15) -> puffiness; cloth_sim mass 0.05, tension_stiffness 2, distance_min 5e-3; sheet x offset(size/2 + uniform 0..0.15); subsurf level 2
    make_cover: cloth_sim mass 0.05, tension_stiffness 2; cover x offset(size/2 + uniform 0..0.3); subsurf level 2

FILE: assets/objects/seating/bedframe.py
  BedFrameFactory: bed frame geometry (seat platform, legs, headboard). ADD post/canopy/curtain geometry here for four-poster.
    knobs: scale(1.0); leg_decor_types(weighted 2 coiled / 2 pad / 1 plain / 2 legs) -> leg base style; back_types(weighted 3 coiled / 3 pad / 2 whole / 1 horizontal-bar / 1 vertical-bar) -> headboard style
    knobs: width(log_uniform 1.4..2.4), size(uniform 2..2.4) -> bed footprint; thickness(uniform 0.05..0.12) -> platform thickness; has_all_legs(uniform<0.2) -> add mid legs; leg_thickness(uniform 0.08..0.12), leg_height(uniform 0.2..0.6) -> leg dimensions (raise dramatically for tall posts); leg_decor_wrapped(uniform<0.5)
    knobs: back_height(uniform 0.5..1.3) -> headboard height; seat_subdivisions_x(randint 1..3), seat_subdivisions_y(int log_uniform 4..10) -> platform mesh density
    knobs: dot_distance(log_uniform 0.16..0.2), dot_size(uniform 0.005..0.02), dot_depth(uniform 0.04..0.08) -> coiled/tufted button pattern; panel_distance(uniform 0.3..0.5), panel_margin(uniform 0.01..0.02) -> quilted panel size/inset
    make_seat: platform grid + solidify + bevel (bevel_width, 8 segments)
    make_legs/make_leg_decors: leg placement, convex-hull decor, coiled/pad styling
    make_back_decors/make_back: headboard build via convex hull + solidify + coiled/pad tufting; bisect at back_height

FILE: assets/objects/seating/chairs/chair.py
  ChairFactory (base for frame): limb (leg/back/arm) bezier construction, seat profile, material assignment.
    knobs: leg_type(vertical/straight/up-curved/down-curved), limb_profile(uniform 1.5..2.5) -> curved leg shape; is_leg_round(uniform<0.5) -> round vs boxy limbs; back_profile / back_vertical_cuts(randint 1..3) -> back bar layout; bevel_width; material selection via material_assignments (surface, panel_surface, limb_surface)
    (BedFrameFactory overrides width/size/leg/back settings; arm disabled)

FILE: assets/objects/seating/mattress.py
  MattressFactory: mattress mesh + coiled/wrapped fabric styling.
    knobs: types(weighted 1 coiled / 1 wrapped); width(log_uniform 0.9..2.0), size(uniform 2..2.4), thickness(uniform 0.2..0.35); dot_distance/dot_size/dot_depth (tufting); wrap_distance(0.05); wrapped cloth_sim uniform_pressure_force(uniform 0.1..0.2)
  make_coiled(function): tufted button geometry — bevel radius(dot_distance*uniform 0.06..0.08), extrude depth(dot_depth), smooth factor(uniform 0.5..1.0, 5 iters)

FILE: assets/objects/seating/pillow.py
  PillowFactory: cloth-simulated pillows.
    knobs: shapes(weighted 4 square / 4 rectangle / 1 circle / 1 torus); width(uniform 0.4..0.7), size(rect: width*log_uniform 0.6..0.8); bevel_width(uniform 0.02..0.05); thickness(log_uniform 0.006..0.008); extrude_thickness(thickness*log_uniform 1..8, 50% chance) -> flange edge; has_seam(uniform<0.3); seam_radius(uniform 0.01..0.02); cloth pressure(square/rect uniform 1..2, torus uniform 8..12); tension_stiffness(uniform 0..5); subsurf level 2

FILE: assets/objects/clothes/blanket.py
  BlanketFactory: flat cloth used for quilt/cover.
    knobs: width(log_uniform 0.9..1.2), size(width*log_uniform 0.4..0.7), thickness(log_uniform 0.004..0.008); grid 64 subdiv; surface from material_assignments.blanket; fold() theta(uniform -pi/6..pi/6), y_margin(size*(0.5-uniform 0.1..0.3))
  ComforterFactory: adds SOLIDIFY thickness 0.01
  BoxComforterFactory: margin(uniform 0.3..0.4) -> box-stitch grid spacing

FILE: assets/objects/clothes/pants.py
  PantsFactory: (not used by bed) garment mesh; type(underwear/shorts/pants), width(log_uniform 0.45..0.55), thickness(log_uniform 0.02..0.03)

FILE: assets/objects/clothes/shirt.py
  ShirtFactory: (not used by bed) garment mesh; type(short/long), sleeve_length/width/angle, thickness

FILE: assets/objects/clothes/__init__.py
  re-exports BlanketFactory, PantsFactory, ShirtFactory, TowelFactory (TowelFactory used for scattered towels)

FILE: assets/objects/seating/__init__.py
  re-exports BedFactory, BedFrameFactory, chair/mattress/pillow/sofa factories

FILE: assets/objects/creatures/util/cloth_sim.py
  local_pos_rigity_mask / bake_cloth: generic cloth-bake helpers (not on bed's main path).
    knobs: gravity(default 1), distance_min(0.015), use_self_collision(False); musgrave scales/colorramp positions for rigidity mask

LINKED TO INFINIGEN (infra — do NOT edit, resolved from the original package):
  assets/composition/material_assignments.py -> weighted material pools (bedframe, fabrics, blanket, pants, furniture_leg/hard_surface, wear_tear)
  assets/materials/art.py -> ArtFabric procedural fabric material (seeded)
  assets/scatters/clothes.py -> cloth_sim() wrapper (mass, tension, pressure, self-collision) for bedding/pillows
  assets/utils/decorate.py -> mesh ops: read_co/write_co, normals, remove/select faces, subsurf, subdivide_edge_ring, decimate, write_attribute
  assets/utils/object.py -> primitive builders: new_grid, new_cube, new_bbox, new_circle, join_objects, obj2trimesh, center
  assets/utils/shapes.py -> dissolve_limited and shape helpers
  assets/utils/uv.py -> UV unwrapping (unwrap_faces, wrap_top_bottom, wrap_front_back)
  assets/utils/draw.py -> align_bezier, bezier_curve, remesh_fill for limb/curve geometry
  assets/utils/nodegroup.py -> geo_radius geometry-nodes group for round limbs
  core/placement/factory.py -> AssetFactory base class / asset spawning
  core/surface.py -> material assignment, geomod application, attribute-to-vertex-group
  core/nodes/node_wrangler.py, node_info.py -> geometry/shader node graph construction
  core/util/blender.py -> ViewportMode, modify_mesh, apply_transform, deep_clone_obj, select helpers
  core/util/random.py -> log_uniform, weighted_sample, random_general (rg) sampling
  core/util/math.py -> FixedSeed deterministic seeding
  core/util/logging.py -> Timer / logging utilities
